ideas.title: Following the Money: An Investigation into Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the measures being taken to prevent it
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What measures are being taken to prevent Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant misconduct and waste of government funds. By following the money and investigating the extent of Medicaid fraud, we may be able to identify patterns and connections that can inform future investigations.
